name_en: Taimeshi — whole sea bream cooked into rice, or laid raw over it in egg-soy sauce
summary_ja: タイを丸ごと米と炊き込む東予の型と、生の切り身を卵と醤油だれに漬けて熱いご飯にのせる南予の型がある。縁起の良い魚とされ祝いの席でも食べられ、家庭ごとにどちらの食べ方が根付くかが分かれるという。
summary_en: Eastern Ehime cooks a whole sea bream into the rice pot; the south instead lays raw fillets marinated in egg and soy over hot rice. Considered an auspicious fish, it appears at celebrations too, and which style a household follows tends to run by region.
source_title: 鯛めし 愛媛県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Satsuma — grilled fish flaked into barley miso and ladled hot over rice
summary_ja: 焼いてほぐした白身魚を麦味噌とすり合わせ、骨でとった出汁でのばして熱い麦飯にかける南予の一杯。ぱさつきがちな麦飯を食べやすくする漁師の工夫と伝わり、地域や家庭で使う魚が違うという。
summary_en: Grilled fish is flaked and worked into barley miso, thinned with a stock from its own bones, and ladled over hot barley rice — a dish of southern Ehime. Said to have started as a fisherman's trick for making dry barley rice easier to eat, with the fish varying by area and household.
source_title: さつま 愛媛県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Ehime Tako Meshi — octopus simmered into rice with kelp and citrus peel
summary_ja: 伊予灘でとれるタコをぶつ切りにし、昆布や根菜と一緒に米に炊き込む。もともと漁船の上で漁師が獲れたタコをそのまま炊いたのが始まりとされ、仕上げにみかんの皮をのせるのが愛媛らしい。
summary_en: Octopus from the Iyo Sea is cut into pieces and cooked into rice with kelp and root vegetables. It's said to have begun with fishermen simmering their catch right on board, and the finishing touch of mikan peel on top is distinctly Ehime.
source_title: たこ飯 愛媛県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_ja: きじ肉と切り干し大根の混ぜご飯
name_romaji: Kijiniku to Kiriboshi Daikon no Mazegohan
name_en: Pheasant and Dried Daikon Mixed Rice — a mild, lean game bird folded into rice with sun-dried radish
summary_ja: きじ骨の出汁できじ肉と切り干し大根、根菜を煮て、炊いたご飯に混ぜ込む鬼北町の一皿。きじは淡泊で熟成に向くとされ、地域で飼育がおこなわれ学校給食にも取り入れられているという。
summary_en: Pheasant meat and sun-dried daikon, along with root vegetables, are simmered in a stock made from pheasant bones and folded into cooked rice — a dish from Kihoku Town. The lean, mild meat is said to suit aging, and the bird is now raised locally and served in school lunches.
source_title: きじ肉と切り干し大根の混ぜご飯 愛媛県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Shoyu Meshi — a soy-simmered mixed rice that became Matsuyama's train-station bento
summary_ja: ごぼうや人参などその時々の野菜を醤油で炊き込む松山地域の祝いご飯。室町時代から続くもてなし料理とされ、昭和に駅弁としてアレンジされたものが今も松山の名物として親しまれている。
summary_en: Burdock, carrot, and other seasonal vegetables are cooked into rice with soy sauce — a celebratory rice dish from the Matsuyama area, said to trace back to Muromachi-era hospitality cooking. A Showa-era bento version, sold at the train station, remains a Matsuyama favorite today.
source_title: しょうゆめし 愛媛県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
